title: Orders That Fully Agree
description:
An order only "fully agrees" between systems if **both** its `order_id` and its `amount` match. Report every `(order_id, amount)` pair that appears in both `source_orders` and `warehouse_orders` exactly as-is.

Name the columns `order_id` and `amount`. Return the result in any order.
hint: INTERSECT compares whole rows (every selected column together), not just the first one — an order_id match with a different amount will not survive here.
outputExplanation: Order 1 ($120) and order 2 ($80) have identical id and amount in both systems. Orders 3 and 4 don't exist in the warehouse at all.

tests.name: Example
All three systems fully agree
Completely disjoint across all three
Source has an accidental duplicate row
Only source has any data
tests.seedSql: INSERT INTO source_orders VALUES (1,'Ann Lee',120.0),(2,'Ben Kim',80.0),(3,'Cy Ortiz',45.5);

tests.name: Same order, inconsistent name formatting
Matching ids, mismatched amounts
Single matching order everywhere
Larger mixed set: some in all three, some in two, some in one, duplicates and a mismatch
No matching amount pairs — same ids, different amounts
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO source_orders VALUES (1,'A',100.0),(2,'B',200.0);
INSERT INTO warehouse_orders VALUES (1,'A',999.0),(2,'B',888.0);

tests.name: All (order_id, amount) pairs match
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO source_orders VALUES (1,'A',100.0),(2,'B',200.0);
INSERT INTO warehouse_orders VALUES (1,'A',100.0),(2,'B',200.0);

tests.name: Same ids, different amounts — no match
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO source_orders VALUES (1,'A',100.0),(2,'B',200.0);
INSERT INTO warehouse_orders VALUES (1,'A',150.0),(2,'B',250.0);

tests.name: Partial overlap in amounts
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO source_orders VALUES (1,'A',100.0),(2,'B',200.0),(3,'C',300.0);
INSERT INTO warehouse_orders VALUES (1,'A',100.0),(2,'B',999.0),(4,'D',400.0);

tests.name: Duplicate matching pairs in source
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO source_orders VALUES (1,'A',100.0),(1,'A',100.0);
INSERT INTO warehouse_orders VALUES (1,'A',100.0);
